shared_elements: upright freestanding slab/stela with carved decoration
standing human figures in low relief
dense field of small repeated glyph-like signs
rectangular panel divisions containing sign blocks
frontal or profile human figure holding/handling an object
carved figures occupying the lower portion, signs above
justification: Both are upright stelae combining standing human figures wearing headdresses with a dense field of small, boxed, repeated script-like signs, and in both the signs are compartmentalised into rows/panels while the figures occupy their own zone. However, A's figure is a single frontal, richly ornamented, deeply modelled personage on a narrow face flanked by a column of glyph blocks, whereas B shows two slender profile figures facing each other across a central element beneath an arched sky-like band, in shallow, spare linear relief with quite different proportions and rendering conventions.
